subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.11 published dist missing reentrancy guard - reply session initialization conflicted

question: Should maintainers cut and promote an immediate stable package correction for the affected v2026.6.11 latest channel, or wait for the next regular stable promotion?
rationale: The source fix exists on main, but npm latest and GitHub latest stable still point at the affected package; choosing the release path, timing, and user advisory belongs to release maintainers rather than an autonomous source-only fix.

options.title: Cut stable correction now
options.body: Publish the next immutable stable/latest version with the current reply-session fixes and package-parity validation so stable users stop losing messages.

options.title: Promote beta after validation
options.body: Use the current beta train as the fix vehicle only after package acceptance and real channel/session proof show it resolves the stable regression.

options.title: Document affected stable only
options.body: Leave v2026.6.11 as latest until the next stable train and publish a clear affected-version workaround/advisory for users who cannot move to beta/main.

recommendation.title: Cut stable correction now
recommendation.body: Publish the next immutable stable/latest version with the current reply-session fixes and package-parity validation so stable users stop losing messages.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman has recent commits in the merged source-side fix and already identified this issue as release/package parity rather than a source-only closure.
